findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed long-term performance, we risk early dimming and frequent replacements in office spaces.

findings.detail:

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: DLC qualification may be required for energy rebates and compliance with project sustainability goals.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: macadam steps
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent color binning could lead to visible color differences between fixtures, affecting lighting quality.

findings.title: Specify option: Dims down to
findings.detail: Dims down to meets the spec only with EZ1 or EZB or GZ1 (1 %). Confirm the order specifies it.
findings.why_it_matters: If the dimming doesn’t go low enough, occupants won’t get the intended lighting control for comfort and energy savings.
